fact: The ICT Minister opened the POTRAZ Strategic Formulation Workshop in Mutare on 2025-11-04, which the source says marks the start of a national process to define the country's digital roadmap for 2026 to 2030; no adopting act or body is named and the workshop is the regulator's.

The Smart Zimbabwe 2030 Master Plan states that it puts in place an institutional arrangement with the mandate to coordinate ICT interventions in all sectors of the economy through the Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services; the document carries no date, so the published date of 2019 is used, and it states no budget line.
